WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(DateKey) AS first_purchase_date
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
cohort_2007 AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM first_purchase
    WHERE toYear(first_purchase_date) = 2007
),
returned_2008 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN cohort_2007 c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008
),
returned_2009 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN returned_2008 r ON f.CustomerKey = r.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count() FROM cohort_2007) AS customers_first_bought_2007,
    (SELECT count() FROM returned_2008) AS came_back_in_2008,
    (SELECT count() FROM returned_2009) AS came_back_again_in_2009
